outcome: early-onset neonatal Group B Streptococcus cases
cohort: The study included 67 Group B Streptococcus-positive pregnant women under midwife care in a rural, midwifery-led birth center.
finding: Membrane stripping was not associated with adverse maternal or neonatal surrogate outcomes in Group B Streptococcus-positive pregnancies.
mod_finding: No effects were observed on birth type (p > 0.99).
birth_weight: Average 3663.0 g in the membrane stripping group vs. 3394.8 g in the control group
gest_age: Average 40.2 weeks in the membrane stripping group vs. 39.4 weeks in the control group
